description: GC-136651: F5 orchestration with inline ERROR log in description about SNATPool

input.description:
Customer env: amdocs-prod-2
Relevant collector (on-prem, gcsh available): ILRNAGCAGG05 F5 orchestration with the issue: aggr-orchestration-f5-165d23cd-1607-4712-94e8-a766bf2531d8
Background:
Customer upgraded their F5 instance to 17.1.1.3 and changed it's ip. This broke some labeling scripts (provided by Akamai professional services) which are running in the background. As a result, the customer is experiencing over-blocking and had to WA the problem with a wide allow policy, which is over allowing. The problem:
During the investigation we found that Guardicore stopped receiving assets metadata for destination pool addresses. This data is crucial for the PS scripts.
Error we see in the orchestration log indicate data inconsistency, but its not clear if this relates to the problem:
```
2026-01-05 05:57:42,482 [1187305:orchestration-spawn:ERROR] model.fetch_all.172: LocalLB.LocalLB.SNATPool.get_member_v2 failed: "[/Common/DNS-old-Vlan761, /Common/ISE-SNAT, /Common/Octane-NAT, /Common/dns-snat-pool, /Common/isrwslproxy-snat, /Common/ms365proxy-snat, /Common/snat-pool-apache]" is not valid for Common.StringSequence; expecting: _arrayType, _offset, _id, _href, _arrayType
2026-01-05 05:58:01,526 [1187305:GreenThread-3:INFO] rabbit._process_message.533: Component id: AGR-6F082042-E609-C5D8-E985-20AD0271238E received message type nop with no callback registered
2026-01-05 05:58:02,784 [1187305:orchestration-spawn:INFO] orchestration_service.update.90: query known ips
2026-01-05 05:58:02,789 [1187305:orchestration-spawn:INFO] orchestration_service.update.117: 976 ip records updates sent
```
Additional comments: we think that this might be related to the new F5 version 17.1.1.3, however so far we have not found an asset that will prove this.

rubric.identifies_error_line: Must capture the ERROR line about LocalLB.LocalLB.SNATPool.get_member_v2 failed
rubric.context_is_accurate: Context should mention SNAT pool member retrieval failure or data type mismatch (StringSequence)
rubric.does_not_hallucinate: Should not invent errors beyond what's in the description
